title: Chess, but there are landmines...
summary: Best-of-three vs Angela, the developer of the 'Landmine Chess' website (lavender board). Before each game each side secretly places three landmines: White on ranks 3-4, Black on ranks 5-6. Any piece that lands on a mine explodes (own pieces included — Angela blows up her own pawn on her g5 mine). Tony wins all three games, mostly on time (flags in games 1 and 3, ~7:39 and ~21:17).
rules: Pre-game placement phase: each side secretly chooses 3 squares for landmines; White's must be on ranks 3-4, Black's on ranks 5-6.
Mines are hidden from the opponent (own mines shown to owner, inferred).
Any piece (either colour) that moves onto a mined square explodes and is removed; the mine is then spent and the square shows a crater.
Squares a piece has safely visited are known to be clear (players deduce mine locations).
Kings: not stated whether a king can explode (inferred: king stepping on a mine loses or is disallowed — UNVERIFIED).
Otherwise normal chess with a blitz clock (games won on time).
win_condition: Checkmate or flag the opponent; best of three.
